trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire visible boundary; characterized by at least 8 prominent peaks on the left lobe and 6 on the right lobe with variable pixel-amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical curvature; the left lobe displays a broad convex sweep while the right lobe shows a more linear, ascending trajectory towards the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white ring patterns (approximately 15 distinct units) distributed across the dark dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of textured, high-intensity calcified bio-fouling (barnacles) concentrated on the distal tips and outer margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The image captures the dorsal surface of the fluke; significant water droplet diffraction is visible across the lower mid-section of the lobes.
